The releases also show adjacent prior-quarter, prior-year, year-to-date and percentage-change columns. The selected comparison uses each filing's first current-quarter or current-as-of-date amount, not those other columns.

Net interest income rose and the period provision fell, but classified and total criticized loans rose between period ends. A lower provision alone does not establish improved credit quality or adequate reserves.

Compensation and total noninterest expense also rose. Net income improved after both higher net interest income and lower provision, but the selected rows do not prove persistence or a specific rate/loan-growth cause.

reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows only; no year-over-year, non-GAAP, guidance or consensus comparison is available in this extract. The selected GAAP quarter rows are consistent with a stronger sequential pre-provision revenue picture: net interest income before provision and total noninterest income both rose, while the credit loss provision declined, so net interest income after provision and pretax income rose. That improvement is partly offset on the expense side, where compensation and total operating noninterest expense rose and total noninterest expense rose even though tax credit and CRA amortization fell; the expense increase is not explained by the selected rows. Income tax expense rose alongside higher pretax income, so the tax line is not evidence of a smaller tax drag. Company-reported point-in-time credit quality rows are mixed: classified loans and total criticized loans rose while special mention loans fell, which is consistent with continued migration into worse risk grades but does not by itself establish loss emergence, and the lower provision sits in tension with that migration. Because the extract contains no loan balances, net charge-offs, nonperforming or allowance detail, no net interest margin or balance-sheet drivers, no non-GAAP reconciliation, no guidance and no management explanation, the selected rows cannot support a defensible causal or forward-looking conclusion. The research state is therefore held for review rather than upgraded or invalidated; conviction and status are unchanged and downstream decisions remain blocked pending a complete filing, period-matched credit detail and any company-defined measures.
